production.note: US model years. The release introduces the '2022 Golf GTI and Golf R'. Still on sale (Volkswagen's US Golf R press kit, vw-us-golf-r-model-page).

body.note: Golf hatchback; inferred from the release.

displacementL.note: 1,984 cc: 'the EA888 evo4 engine displaces 1,984 cc' (2026 Golf R press kit); the 2022 release calls it the '2.0-liter' EA888 (vw-us-2022-golf-gti-r-chicago).

fuel.note: Inferred: a TSI gasoline engine with no hybrid system.

drivetrain.note: '4Motion all-wheel-drive system with rear-axle torque vectoring'

transmission.note: 'can be paired with a standard six-speed manual transmission or an optional seven-speed DSG® dual-clutch automatic' (DSG is a DCT). The manual was later dropped: the 2026 press kit lists only 'a 7-speed DSG dual-clutch automatic transmission' (vw-us-golf-r-model-page); the year the manual ended was not confirmed.

powerHp.note: Quote: "now makes 315 horsepower". 315 hp is the launch rating (2022-2024); Volkswagen's current US press kit (2026 model year) says the engine 'now produces 328 horsepower (achieved using premium fuel) at 5,850 rpm' (vw-us-golf-r-model-page); the first model year with 328 hp was not confirmed. The launch rating covers more model years so far, so 2022 is the reference year.

weightLb.note: PROVISIONAL, from databases. Golf R with the 6-speed manual. Cars.com: "Base Curb Weight: 3,417 lbs" (2022 Golf R, 'Transmission Options: M/T 6-Speed M/T'). MotorMatchup gives the same: "Curb Weight: 3,417 lbs" for the 2022 Golf R 2.0T Manual (motormatchup-2022-golf-r-manual).

sources.title: Volkswagen introduces 2022 Golf GTI and Golf R at the Chicago Auto Show

provisionalNote: Weight is provisional: 3,417 lb rests on Cars.com and MotorMatchup (databases) for the 2022 Golf R manual. A Volkswagen of America technical-specifications sheet or a major magazine's spec panel would replace it.
